definitions.gloss: unique; peerless; matchless; one and only
definitions.explanation: Having no equal or duplicate; something or someone so special that there is no second.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無二|むに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧だ。
examples.english: He is my one and only best friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無二|むに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This work is said to be a peerless masterpiece.

examples.japanese: ⟦{唯一無二|ゆいいつむに}→唯一無二：20617_yuiitsumuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}って→失う：01887_ushinau⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: After losing her — a truly one-of-a-kind presence — the world felt as if it had lost its color.

notes:
Literally means "without a second" — ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without/none) + ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧ (two/second). The word expresses the idea that something is so exceptional that there is nothing else like it.

Most commonly encountered in the four-character compound ⟦{唯一無二|ゆいいつむに}→唯一無二：20617_yuiitsumuni⟧ (one and only; absolutely unique), which is widely used in both spoken and written Japanese. On its own, {無二|むに} appears primarily in the set phrase {無二|むに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧ (irreplaceable best friend) and in literary contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無二|むに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧: irreplaceable best friend
- ⟦{唯一無二|ゆいいつむに}→唯一無二：20617_yuiitsumuni⟧: one and only; absolutely unique
- {無二|むに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧: a peerless existence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧: the only; sole (more commonly used alone)
- ⟦{無比|むひ}→無比：23930_muhi⟧: unrivaled; incomparable
- {無双|むそう}: peerless; unmatched
